# {.sidebar}

### Filters

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sales = FileAttachment("transaction_month.csv").csv({ typed: true }).then(rows =>
  rows.flatMap(row => {
    if (typeof row.Source !== "string") return [];
    const yearMonth = row.Year_Month instanceof Date
      ? `${row.Year_Month.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(row.Year_Month.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`
      : String(row.Year_Month ?? "").slice(0, 7);
    const year = Number(yearMonth.slice(0, 4));
    const monthNumber = Number(yearMonth.slice(5, 7));
    const grossSales = Number(row.Gross_sales);
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(year) ||
      !Number.isInteger(monthNumber) ||
      monthNumber < 1 ||
      monthNumber > 12 ||
      !Number.isFinite(grossSales)
    ) return [];

    return [{
      Year: year,
      Month: new Date(Date.UTC(2000, monthNumber - 1)).toLocaleString("en", { month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }),
      Month_Number: monthNumber,
      Year_Month: yearMonth,
      Source: row.Source,
      Gross_sales: grossSales
    }];
  })
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sourceNames = [...new Set(sales.map(d => d.Source))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedSource = Inputs.select(["All sources", ...sourceNames], {
  label: "Sales source",
  value: "All sources"
})
```

Data for Oct 2026 is incomplete - download on 10/20/2026

# Sales Over Time {orientation="rows" scrolling="true"}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedSales = selectedSource === "All sources"
  ? sales
  : sales.filter(d => d.Source === selectedSource)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
timelineMonths = [...new Set(sales.map(d => d.Year_Month))].sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sourceColors = new Map(sourceNames.map((source, index) => [
  source,
  ["#56b4e9", "#f0a35e", "#69c3a5", "#c79bea", "#f18b9c"][index % 5]
]))
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
plotStyle = Object.freeze({ background: "#42464d", color: "#f1f3f5" })
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
timelineBars = {
  const monthIndex = new Map(timelineMonths.map((month, index) => [month, index + 1]));
  const sourceIndex = new Map(sourceNames.map((source, index) => [source, index]));
  const monthTotals = new Map();

  return selectedSales
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) =>
      a.Year_Month.localeCompare(b.Year_Month) ||
      sourceIndex.get(a.Source) - sourceIndex.get(b.Source)
    )
    .map(d => {
      const y1 = monthTotals.get(d.Year_Month) || 0;
      const y2 = y1 + d.Gross_sales;
      monthTotals.set(d.Year_Month, y2);
      const x = monthIndex.get(d.Year_Month);
      return {
        ...d,
        x1: x - 0.42,
        x2: x + 0.42,
        x,
        y1,
        y2
      };
    });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
yearlySales = {
  const totals = new Map();
  for (const d of selectedSales) {
    totals.set(d.Year, (totals.get(d.Year) || 0) + d.Gross_sales);
  }
  return [...totals]
    .map(([Year, Gross_sales]) => ({ Year, Gross_sales }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.Year - b.Year);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Sales Trends Over Time
Plot.plot({
  width: 700,
  height: 440,
  marginBottom: 90,
  style: plotStyle,
  x: {
    domain: [0.5, Math.max(timelineMonths.length, 1) + 0.5],
    ticks: timelineMonths
      .map((_, index) => index + 1)
      .filter((_, index) => index % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(timelineMonths.length / 24)) === 0),
    tickFormat: index => timelineMonths[Math.round(index) - 1] ?? "",
    tickRotate: -45,
    label: "Year-month"
  },
  y: { label: "Gross sales", grid: true, zero: true },
  color: {
    type: "ordinal",
    domain: selectedSource === "All sources" ? sourceNames : [selectedSource],
    range: (selectedSource === "All sources" ? sourceNames : [selectedSource])
      .map(source => sourceColors.get(source)),
    legend: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(timelineBars, {
      x1: "x1",
      x2: "x2",
      y1: "y1",
      y2: "y2",
      fill: "Source"
    }),
    Plot.tip(timelineBars, Plot.pointer({
      x: "x",
      y: d => (d.y1 + d.y2) / 2,
      fill: "#f1f3f5",
      stroke: "#212529",
      title: d => `${d.Year_Month} · ${d.Source}: ${d.Gross_sales.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD" })}`
    })),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

# Year-over-Year {orientation="rows" scrolling="true"}

## Monthly and Cumulative Sales

```{ojs}
//| output: false
comparisonYears = [...new Set(sales.map(d => d.Year))].sort((a, b) => a - b)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
comparisonMonthCount = Math.max(
  ...sales
    .filter(d => d.Year === comparisonYears[comparisonYears.length - 1])
    .map(d => d.Month_Number)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
yearlyMonthlySales = {
  const totals = new Map();
  for (const d of selectedSales) {
    const key = `${d.Year}-${d.Month_Number}`;
    totals.set(key, (totals.get(key) || 0) + d.Gross_sales);
  }

  const slotWidth = 0.82 / Math.max(comparisonYears.length, 1);
  return comparisonYears.flatMap((year, yearIndex) => {
    let cumulative = 0;
    return Array.from({ length: comparisonMonthCount }, (_, index) => {
      const monthNumber = index + 1;
      const grossSales = totals.get(`${year}-${monthNumber}`) || 0;
      cumulative += grossSales;
      const x1 = monthNumber - 0.41 + yearIndex * slotWidth;
      return {
        Year: String(year),
        Month: new Date(Date.UTC(2000, index)).toLocaleString("en", { month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }),
        Month_Number: monthNumber,
        Gross_sales: grossSales,
        Cumulative_sales: cumulative,
        x1,
        x2: x1 + slotWidth
      };
    });
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Sales by Month Year-over-year
html`<div style="display: grid; gap: 1rem;">

      })),

    ]
  })}
  ${Plot.plot({
    width: 700,
    height: 340,
    style: plotStyle,
    x: {
      domain: [1, comparisonMonthCount],
      ticks: comparisonMonthCount,
      tickFormat: monthNumber => new Date(Date.UTC(2000, monthNumber - 1))
        .toLocaleString("en", { month: "short", timeZone: "UTC" }),
      label: "Month"
    },
    y: { label: "Cumulative gross sales", grid: true, zero: true },
    color: {
      type: "ordinal",
      domain: comparisonYears.map(String),

      legend: true
    },

      })),

</div>`
```
